focus_areas: heat resistance, stain resistance, scratch resistance, impact resistance
warranty terms — transferable? lifetime? what's actually excluded?
known failure modes (chipping, cracking, delamination, discoloration)
certification status (Greenguard, Greenguard Gold, NSF 51, HPD, Declare)
material safety — resin content, off-gassing, sealer requirements, PFAS exposure
repairability — can damage be fixed or does the slab need replacement?
manufacturing origin — single factory vs multi-source, domestic vs imported
exclude_from_scoring: silicosis / fabrication dust exposure (Manufacturing vs Consumer Hazard Rule)
Australian engineered stone bans (manufacturing safety, not consumer safety)
installation difficulty (fabricator skill, not product quality)

sources.name: Consumer Reports
sources.notes: Material-type testing (impact, stain, heat, scratch). Found Dekton split weakness. Strong on comparative testing, less on per-brand depth.

A.description: Professional reviewers, building science experts, named contractors/fabricators

sources.name: Karin Kirk / Countertop Investigator
sources.notes: Geologist, independent, deep on natural stone and material safety

sources.name: Fabricator forums (Reddit r/Stonefabrication, Houzz pro threads)

tier_1.label: Best in Class

anchors.rationale: Domestic premium quartz ceiling. USA-manufactured, transferable lifetime warranty, fabricator consensus #1.
Best material properties + Material Safety. Dinged by impact brittleness, fabrication complexity, shorter track record.

tier_1.reserved_note: No current countertop product earns this. Reserved for theoretical perfection across all axes.

anchors.rationale: Premium branded quartz, innovation leader. Cosentino financially stable. 25-year transferable warranty.
Legacy premium. Product quality strong but Conditional outlook — 100% outsourced mfg, major financial distress.
Premium dark granite. Proven track record, no resin. PFAS sealer Yellow Finding.
Volume leader, solid mid-tier. 25+ global suppliers, non-transferable warranty, distributor-brand model.
Standard light granite. Higher porosity, more sealer dependence than dark species.
Functional solid surface. Repairable, seamless, but scratches, yellows, dated perception.
Premium laminate. Improved dramatically but edge delamination, non-repairable, perception problem.

quality.description: Manufacturing precision, consistency, edge profiles, pattern depth/realism, slab-to-slab variation

performance.description: Heat resistance, stain resistance, scratch resistance. Flat within material class — quartz is quartz. Reported but compresses to narrow range.
performance.compression_note: Performance axis compresses within material class. Cross-class differences are meaningful (sintered stone heat resistance >> quartz) but within-class differences are minimal.

durability.description: Chip resistance, long-term wear, repairability, warranty reality (transferable? lifetime? what's covered?)

material_safety.description: Resin off-gassing (quartz), sealer PFAS (granite), inert composition (sintered stone). Flag-based, not gap-based.

verified_specs.description: Is warranty transferable to new owner?
Does the product require periodic sealing?

material_class_adjustments.description: Replaces window operation_type adjustments. Material class influences baseline within tier.
material_class_adjustments.notes: Material class adjustments are minimal because tier placement already accounts for material class. Light granite gets -1 for higher porosity/sealer dependence. Marble gets -2 for durability penalty (etching, staining). These are WITHIN-TIER adjustments only.

category_specific.name: No Cross-Class Ranking Rule
category_specific.description: Material class establishes baseline. Composite IS cross-class.

category_specific.name: Mislabeled Stone Rule
category_specific.description: Flag in report if product sold under misleading geological name.

category_specific.name: PFAS Sealer Yellow Finding Rule
category_specific.description: Advisory, not score impact. Buyer can choose PFAS-free sealers.

category_specific.name: Manufacturing vs Consumer Hazard Rule
category_specific.description: Silicosis from fabrication excluded. Score what reaches occupant.

category_specific.name: Adjacent Product Rule
category_specific.description: Material Safety scores installed product, not companion products.

category_specific.name: Certification Tier Rule
category_specific.description: No docking for cert tier differences when both confirm concern managed.

category_specific.name: Corporate Risk Rule
category_specific.description: Outlook modifier (Strong/Stable/Conditional/Negative). Does NOT change composite. Prominently displayed.
